info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Tax Handling Retrieval API provides access to specific consumer service information based on provided parameters. This endpoint enables businesses to retrieve detailed insights regarding tax handling for individual customers, facilitating improved customer service and operational efficiency. Developers and financial service providers typically utilize this API to ensure compliance and enhance customer interactions through tailored tax-related support. The API streamlines processes by allowing quick and precise access to crucial consumer data.

get.summary: Retrieve tax handling information for a specific customer.
get.description: Fetches the tax handling details associated with the specified customer ID, providing insights into their tax-related data. This endpoint is essential for understanding and managing customer tax information effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve customer tax handling information for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Please ensure that all required fields are populated correctly before submission.
